questions.question: A and B contribute to a business investment in the ratio 3:5. They earn a profit of ₹64,000. A is a working partner and receives 10% of the profit extra. What is A's total share?
questions.questionHtml: A and B contribute to a business investment in the ratio 3:5. They earn a profit of ₹64,000. A is a working partner and receives 10% of the profit extra. What is A's total share?
questions.solution:
⇒ Extra profit to A = 10 ÷ 100 × 64000 = 6400

⇒ Remaining profit = 64000 − 6400 = 57600

⇒ Share of A from remaining profit = 3 ÷ 8 × 57600 = 21600

⇒ Total share of A = 21600 + 6400 = 28000

questions.question: In a team of 75 employees, the average monthly sales per employee is ₹ 1.8 lakh. If 30 junior employees average ₹ 1.2 lakh each, what is the average monthly sales figure (in ₹ lakh) for the senior employees?
questions.questionHtml: In a team of 75 employees, the average monthly sales per employee is ₹ 1.8 lakh. If 30 junior employees average ₹ 1.2 lakh each, what is the average monthly sales figure (in ₹ lakh) for the senior employees?
questions.solution:
<svg width="550" height="320" viewBox="0 0 550 320" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: AVERAGE DEVIATION VISUAL -->
  <!-- Baseline -->
  <line x1="20" y1="180" x2="350" y2="180" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Junior Employee Bars (Ratio 2) -->
  <rect x="40" y="120" width="30" height="60" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="75" y="120" width="30" height="60" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="42" y="115" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">1.2</text>
  <text x="40" y="198" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">Junior (30)</text>

  <!-- Senior Employee Bars (Ratio 3) -->
  <rect x="200" y="70" width="30" height="110" fill="#d9f2f2" stroke="#008080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="235" y="70" width="30" height="110" fill="#d9f2f2" stroke="#008080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="270" y="70" width="30" height="110" fill="#d9f2f2" stroke="#008080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="215" y="65" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#008080">2.2</text>
  <text x="205" y="198" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#008080">Senior (45)</text>

  <!-- Overall Average Line (1.8) -->
  <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="350" y2="90" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,3"/>
  <text x="355" y="95" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#cc0000" font-weight="700">Avg = 1.8</text>

  <!-- Deviation Shading -->
  <!-- Junior Deficit Area (2 parts * 0.6) -->
  <rect x="40" y="90" width="65" height="30" fill="#ffd6d6" fill-opacity="0.6"/>
  <text x="50" y="108" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#cc0000">−0.6 per head</text>
  
  <!-- Senior Surplus Area (3 parts * 0.4) -->
  <rect x="200" y="70" width="100" height="20" fill="#ccffcc" fill-opacity="0.6"/>
  <text x="205" y="85" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#007700">+0.4 per head</text>

  <!-- Icons -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="170" r="5" fill="#2255cc"/>
  <path d="M25,180 Q30,170 35,180" fill="#2255cc"/>
  <circle cx="190" cy="165" r="7" fill="#008080"/>
  <path d="M180,180 Q190,165 200,180" fill="#008080"/>

  <!-- ZONE 2: CALCULATION -->
  <text x="30" y="235" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Ratio Junior : Senior = 30 : 45 = 2 : 3</text>
  <text x="30" y="260" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Total Junior Deficit = 2 × (1.8 − 1.2) = 1.2</text>
  <text x="30" y="285" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Senior Avg = 1.8 + (1.2 ÷ 3) = 2.2</text>
  
  <text x="30" y="310" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = ₹ 2.2 lakh</text>
</svg>

  <path d="M300,75 Q360,110 300,145" fill="none" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>

  <text x="30" y="245" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 20 : 50 = 2 : 5</text>

questions.question: The ratio of boys to girls in a school is 7:5. If 20 more girls join the school, the new ratio of boys to girls becomes 7:6. What is the total number of students in the school initially?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of boys to girls in a school is 7:5. If 20 more girls join the school, the new ratio of boys to girls becomes 7:6. What is the total number of students in the school initially?
questions.solution:
Let initial boys = 7k and initial girls = 5k.

New girls = 5k + 20, (7k) ÷ (5k + 20) = 7 ÷ 6.

6 × 7k = 7 × (5k + 20) ⇒ 42k = 35k + 140 ⇒ 7k = 140 ⇒ k = 20.

Initial boys = 7 × 20 = 140, Initial girls = 5 × 20 = 100.

Total initial students = 140 + 100 = 240.

questions.question: A, B, and C are capable of completing a job in 30, 45, and 90 days, respectively. A works every day, while B and C join A every fifth day. How long will it take to finish the task?
questions.questionHtml: A, B, and C are capable of completing a job in 30, 45, and 90 days, respectively. A works every day, while B and C join A every fifth day. How long will it take to finish the task?
questions.solution:
⇒ LCM of 30, 45, 90 = 90

⇒ Total work = 90 units

⇒ Efficiency of A = 90 ÷ 30 = 3 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 90 ÷ 45 = 2 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of C = 90 ÷ 90 = 1 unit/day

⇒ On normal day, work done = 3 units

⇒ On every 5th day, work done = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 units

⇒ Work done in 5 days = (4 × 3) + 6 = 12 + 6 = 18 units

⇒ Total work = 90 units

⇒ Number of 5-day cycles = 90 ÷ 18 = 5

⇒ Total days = 5 × 5 = 25 days

questions.question: The ratio of the efficiencies of two workers, P and Q, is 5 : 2. If P can complete a project in 12 days, how many days will Q take to complete the same project alone?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the efficiencies of two workers, P and Q, is 5 : 2. If P can complete a project in 12 days, how many days will Q take to complete the same project alone?
questions.solution:
Efficiency ratio of P and Q = 5:2

Total work = 5 × 12 = 60

Time taken by Q = 60 ÷ 2 = 30 days

questions.question: A car starts from point P on a circular track and an SUV starts from point Q, which is 600 meters ahead of P in the direction of motion. The car's speed is 15 m/s, and the SUV's speed is 10 m/s. The circumference of the track is 1.5 km. How much distance will the car have traveled when it first overtakes the SUV?
questions.questionHtml: A car starts from point P on a circular track and an SUV starts from point Q, which is 600 meters ahead of P in the direction of motion. The car's speed is 15 m/s, and the SUV's speed is 10 m/s. The circumference of the track is 1.5 km. How much distance will the car have traveled when it first overtakes the SUV?
questions.solution:
<svg width="500" height="310" viewBox="0 0 500 310" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2255cc"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrO" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc5500"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: Mechanism - Circular Motion -->
  <!-- Circular Track -->
  <circle cx="250" cy="100" r="75" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-dasharray="5,3" />
  <text x="220" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">1.5 km</text>

  <!-- Point P (Car) -->
  <circle cx="250" cy="175" r="5" fill="#2255cc" />
  <text x="245" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc" font-weight="700">P</text>
  <rect x="235" y="160" width="30" height="12" rx="2" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <circle cx="240" cy="172" r="3" fill="#2255cc" />
  <circle cx="260" cy="172" r="3" fill="#2255cc" />
  <text x="270" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">15 m/s</text>

  <!-- Point Q (SUV) -->
  <!-- 600m ahead = (600/1500)*360 = 144 degrees clockwise from bottom (P) -->
  <circle cx="189" cy="40" r="5" fill="#cc5500" />
  <text x="175" y="30" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500" font-weight="700">Q</text>
  <rect x="165" y="45" width="30" height="15" rx="2" fill="#fff0cc" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <circle cx="172" cy="60" r="3" fill="#cc5500" />
  <circle cx="188" cy="60" r="3" fill="#cc5500" />
  <text x="125" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500">10 m/s</text>

  <!-- Gap Representation -->
  <path d="M 250,175 A 75,75 0 0 1 189,40" fill="none" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)" />
  <text x="310" y="60" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc0000">Gap = 600 m</text>
  
  <!-- Direction of Motion -->
  <path d="M 335,100 A 85,85 0 0 1 320,150" fill="none" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arr)" />

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution -->
  <text x="30" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Relative Speed = 15 − 10 = 5 m/s</text>
  <text x="30" y="250" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Time to Overtake = 600 ÷ 5 = 120 s</text>
  <text x="30" y="275" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Car Distance = 15 × 120 = 1800 m</text>
  
  <text x="30" y="300" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 1800 m</text>
</svg></answer>

questions.question: A circular park having a radius of 14 m. If a 1.5 m wide path is built around it, what is the approximate area of the path?
questions.questionHtml: A circular park having a radius of 14 m. If a 1.5 m wide path is built around it, what is the approximate area of the path?
questions.solution:
Let outer radius R = 14 + 1.5 = 15.5 m.

Area of path = π(R2 − r2) = π(15.52 − 142) = π(240.25 − 196).

Area of path ≈ 3.14 × 44.25 ≈ 139 m2.

questions.question: What is \(\frac{5\pi}{4}\) radians in degrees?
questions.questionHtml: What is \(\frac{5\pi}{4}\) radians in degrees?
questions.solution:
Degrees = Radians × 180/π

⇒ Degrees = (5π/4) × 180/π

⇒ Degrees = (5 × 180)/4

questions.question: The line y = -x + 4 passes through which of the following points?
questions.questionHtml: The line y = -x + 4 passes through which of the following points?
questions.solution:
For Point 1 (2, 2):

⇒ Substitute x = 2, y = 2 into y = −x + 4

⇒ 2 = −(2) + 4

⇒ 2 = 2 (True)

For Point 2 (5, 4):

⇒ Substitute x = 5, y = 4 into y = −x + 4

⇒ 4 = −(5) + 4

⇒ 4 ≠ −1 (False)

For Point 3 (1, 2):

⇒ Substitute x = 1, y = 2 into y = −x + 4

⇒ 2 = −(1) + 4

⇒ 2 ≠ 3 (False)

For Point 4 (3, 6):

⇒ Substitute x = 3, y = 6 into y = −x + 4

⇒ 6 = −(3) + 4

⇒ 6 ≠ 1 (False)

questions.question: What is the central angle of a sector with an arc length of 10 cm in a circle of radius 5 cm?
questions.questionHtml: What is the central angle of a sector with an arc length of 10 cm in a circle of radius 5 cm?
questions.solution:
Central angle = Arc length ÷ Radius

⇒ Central angle = 10 ÷ 5

⇒ Central angle = 2 radians

questions.questionHtml: If tan(90° – A) = √3, what is sin A?
questions.solution:
tan(90º − A) = cot A

cot A = √3 ⇒ A = 30º

sin A = sin 30º = 1 ÷ 2

questions.question: The angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are in the ratio 1:2:3:4. What is the measure of the smallest angle?
questions.questionHtml: The angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are in the ratio 1:2:3:4. What is the measure of the smallest angle?
questions.solution:
Sum of angles = 360°.

Total of ratio = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10.

Smallest angle = (1 ÷ 10) × 360° = 36°.

questions.question: If \(secA = \frac{13}{5}\) and A is acute, find \(sinA\)
questions.questionHtml: If \(secA = \frac{13}{5}\)and A is acute, find \(sinA\)
questions.solution:
secA = 13/5 ⇒ hypotenuse = 13, adjacent = 5

Using Pythagoras theorem: 132 = 52 + opposite2 ⇒ 169 = 25 + opposite2 ⇒ opposite2 = 144

opposite = √144 = 12 ⇒ sinA = 12/13
